Name: Zelophehad, Son of Manasseh
Summary: Second son named in Manasseh's line, who had daughters.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:15: Second son named in Manasseh's line, who had daughters.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zelophehad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
